description:
Position Description
   

  

 We are seeking an energetic and experienced Scrum Master with 3 to 6 years of experience to lead our Agile teams. In this role, you will champion Agile and SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) principles, facilitate key ceremonies, and partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate has a strong technical background in tracking tools like JIRA and excels at data\-driven reporting to drive continuous team improvement.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Facilitate Agile Ceremonies: Lead Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure team alignment and momentum.
   

  

 Scale with SAFe: Guide the team through SAFe practices, aligning delivery with Program Increment (PI) objectives and cross\-team dependencies.
   

  

 Track \& Report Metrics: Leverage JIRA to manage backlogs, track workflows, and generate actionable reports (e.g., velocity, burndown/burnup charts, cumulative flow) for stakeholders.
   

  

 Remove Impediments: Proactively identify, track, and resolve blockers to protect the team's focus and velocity.
   

  

 Coach \& Mentor: Foster a culture of psychological safety, continuous improvement, and self\-organization within the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience working as a Scrum Master in software development environments.
   

  

 Certification: Mandatory SAFe Certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master \- SSM or SAFe Agilist \- SA).
   

  

 Agile Expertise: Deep understanding of Agile frameworks, Scrum values, Kanban principles, and scaling patterns.
   

  

 Tool Proficiency: Hands\-on expertise with JIRA (creating custom dashboards, filters, epics, and advanced reporting).
   

  

 Communication \& Collaboration: Exceptional stakeholder management, conflict\-resolution, and transparent reporting skills.
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

description:
TJX Companies
At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

**Title:** Senior Staff Scrum Master

 **What you’ll discover**

* Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities
* Global IT Organization which collaborates across U.S., Canada, Europe, Australia and India, click here to learn more.
* Challenging, collaborative, and team\-based environment
 **Tower Profile**


The Platform Integration and Enablement organization is responsible for delivering, operating, and continuously improving the foundational infrastructure platforms that enable TJX applications and enterprise services. PIE provides resilient, scalable, and secure infrastructure capabilities across data centers, cloud environments, stores, and distribution centers, forming the core platform layer on which application teams build and run solutions.

 **What you’ll do**


As a Senior Staff Scrum Master, your core responsibilities will include managing the flow of work throughout the tower, assisting teams to clear obstacles, managing risks, resolving issues, and delivering on commitments. You will work closely with the Product, Delivery, and Engineering teams, planning, coordinating, and executing the deployment into production for large epics/initiatives that span multiple product and shared services teams.

 **What you’ll need**


We seek creative, customer\-focused individuals with technical knowledge and a mindset for continuous improvement that have significant experience working with Agile Methodology and Software Development Lifecycle and leading moderate to complex assignments. Individuals must have significant experience working with Product Requirements, Solution Design and stakeholder management.


Advanced knowledge in Lean Agile Mindset, excellent communication skills and influencing skills combined with paradoxical \& Agile Thinking

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in technology delivery, including 7\+ years’ operating in Agile environments as a Program Manager, Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Technical Delivery Lead utilizing Scrum and SAFe frameworks.
* Proven experience serving as a Scrum Master or Program Manager supporting Infrastructure \& Operations initiatives, including cloud, platform, database, middleware, network, and data center programs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and track delivery of infrastructure projects, releases, migrations, upgrades, patching activities, and production deployments using Agile and enterprise delivery tools.
* Experience establishing and reporting delivery metrics, operational KPIs, flow metrics, and program health indicators to measure team performance and drive continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies, including networking, compute, storage, databases, backup and recovery, monitoring, scheduling, middleware, and cloud platforms.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and supporting ART planning, readiness activities, dependency management, and cross\-team coordination across multiple infrastructure workstreams.
* Expertise in Kanban practices, flow optimization, and Flow Board management to improve predictability and throughput for operational and infrastructure teams.
* Proven ability to identify, manage, and escalate risks, issues, blockers, and technical dependencies while driving timely resolution across engineering and support organizations.
* Experience collaborating with infrastructure engineers, architects, operations teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to define requirements, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise delivery and operational processes, leveraging tools such as Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, ServiceNow, and Power BI to drive transparency, governance, and execution.
* Experience supporting infrastructure change management, release management, incident management, and production readiness activities within regulated enterprise environments.
* Ability to influence outcomes beyond the immediate team by driving process improvements, standardization, and operational efficiencies across teams, programs, and Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
* Proven track record of mentoring Scrum Masters, facilitating Communities of Practice, and promoting Agile best practices across the organization.
* Strong customer\-focus and service\-oriented mindset with the ability to balance delivery commitments, operational stability, and business priorities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical and delivery status to engineers, leadership, and business stakeholders.
* Experience supporting multiple teams or complex infrastructure portfolios while maintaining delivery alignment, operational excellence, and organizational objectives.
 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven expertise leading Agile delivery across Infrastructure \& Operations programs, including platform modernization, cloud adoption, operating system upgrades, database refreshes, network initiatives, and large\-scale migration efforts.
* Strong experience facilitating Scrum and SAFe ceremonies at both team and ART levels, including Sprint Planning, PI Planning, Release Planning, Inspect \& Adapt, and Scrum of Scrums.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multiple cross\-functional teams delivering concurrent releases, infrastructure migrations, production deployments, and operational initiatives while maintaining alignment with portfolio and release objectives.
* Experience partnering with Infrastructure Engineering, Security, Mainframe, Platform, and Operations teams to manage, prioritize, and track work across multiple initiatives and dependencies.
* Strong infrastructure domain knowledge including AIX, SQL Server, Oracle Cloud, virtualization, storage, networking, backup and recovery, monitoring, scheduling, and platform lifecycle management.
* Solid understanding of network and security concepts, including firewalls, load balancing, Zero Trust architecture, vulnerability management, and micro\-segmentation.
* Proven ability to establish and monitor delivery, flow, operational, and quality metrics, leveraging data\-driven insights to improve predictability, team performance, and delivery outcomes.
* Experience leveraging Agile and enterprise tools including Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, ServiceNow, Mural, and Power BI to drive governance, transparency, reporting, and execution.
* Strong understanding of Solution Delivery Lifecycle (SDLC), DevSecOps practices, SDP controls, change management, release management, and operational readiness processes.
* Demonstrated success managing risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations while proactively driving resolution across teams and leadership stakeholders.
* Ability to protect teams from external disruptions, improve flow efficiency, support ART readiness activities, and optimize Kanban and Agile delivery practices.
* Proven experience fostering high\-performing teams through coaching, mentoring, conflict resolution, and servant leadership, including mentoring less experienced Scrum Masters and leading Communities of Practice.
* Experience collaborating with business partners, product teams, architects, and engineering teams to define requirements, document acceptance criteria, and align delivery outcomes with business objectives.
* Strong customer\-focused mindset with exceptional communication, facilitation, influencing, negotiation, and presentation skills across technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced environments, effectively reprioritize competing demands, and drive continuous improvement through innovation and problem\-solving.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent technology delivery experience required.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI\-ACP, SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), SAFe Advanced Scrum Master (SASM), or related Agile certification preferred.
* Scrum Master (CSM), PMI\-ACP, SAFe certification preferred.
* Hands\-on experience participating in and leading Scrum/SAFe events, such as Sprint Planning, Release Planning, and Program Increment (PI) Planning

description:

Letitbex AI is a fast\-growing AI\-driven technology company focused on building intelligent, scalable, and enterprise\-grade solutions. We work at the intersection of AI, data engineering, cloud, and business transformation, helping organizations unlock real value from artificial intelligence.  

Position: Technical Lead
Experience: 12\+ Years
Notice Period: Can be considered up 15 Days  

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**
==============================

* Provide technical direction and Lead **full\-stack**, multi\-disciplinary engineering function covering **Angular/TypeScript** frontends, **C\#/.NET backend services** and integration with **SignalR.**
* Experience in developing **Python3\.10 backend services.**
* Own delivery from backlog shaping and requirements clarification through estimation, planning, execution, test completion, release readiness and post\-delivery stabilization
* Lead **architecture and design reviews**, govern engineering standards, and ensure technical decisions align with the architecture team and broader product strategy.
* Drive quality engineering across unit, component, API, integration, regression and end\-to\-end testing using **Playwright** and Oversee defect triage and root\-cause analysis
* **Coordinate with UX, Product Management** to translate user and workflow needs into consistent, responsive and maintainable product experiences.
* Coordinate with DevOps and release owners on **CI/CD, container images, Kubernetes** environments, package/dependency management, configuration, vulnerability scanning, **SBOM and release\-build** expectations.
* **Coach team members, conduct constructive reviews**, support performance and competency development, manage delivery and technical risks, and communicate status, decisions and escalations to stakeholders.
* Ensure **authentication, authorization**, session management, performance, reliability, browser compatibility, maintainability and data consistency are addressed throughout the lifecycle.
* Experience with Atlassian tools **(Jira, Confluence).**

**Qualification**
=================


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation or a related engineering discipline; equivalent demonstrable experience may be considered.
12\+ years of software development experience, including substantial technical leadership, people management and project/program delivery responsibility**Essential Skills**
====================

* **People and technical leadership:** Experience in cross functional and leading, development/testing teams, mentoring senior and junior staff, setting standards, resolving conflicts and maintaining delivery accountability in a distributed environment.

* development of **C\#/.NET Web API, Services**

* development of interactive capabilities and using **WebGL**, **Storybook**

* **Project and program management:** Proven ability in **Agile/Scrum** and project management tools **Jira, Confluence** to plan scope, estimates, milestones, resources, dependencies etc.
* **Data and storage:** Working knowledge of **MongoDB and MinIO/object\-storage** patterns.
* **Quality leadership:** Strong understanding of **automated test strategy** and quality gates across frontend, backend, API, integration and end\-to\-end layers, including **Playwright**
* **Secure software delivery:** Sound knowledge of **cybersecurity principles, secure\-development practices, authentication, authorization, role\-based access, token/session management**, **dependency risk and vulnerability remediation**.
* **Stakeholder management:** Ability to **communicate plans**, risks, trade\-offs and technical proposals to **Product, UX, QA, Systems, Architecture, DevOps, Release Engineering** and **customer, stakeholders.**

**Desired Skills**
==================

* Experience with **Kubernetes basics:** **pods, services, probes, config maps ,logs, infrastructure, deployment environments.**
* **Secure delivery pipeline:** Experience **with CI/CD automation**, container\-image creation, automated release processes, dependency and package management, vulnerability scanning, and **Software Bill of Materials (SBOM**) generation.
* Experience with **ELK, Prometheus and Grafana** for diagnostics and operational visibility.
* Experience with **Keycloak integration**, role\-based access control (RBAC), token handling, authentication flows and session lifecycle management.
